<action type="say">
I can set that up.

To book a plumber, I need a few details first:

1) Address/location:  
   • What’s the full address (or at least city + ZIP) where the kitchen sink is?

2) Timing and urgency:  
   • Is this an emergency (risk of flooding, can’t shut water off) or can it be handled as routine?  
   • What days/times work for you? (e.g., “today after 4 pm,” “tomorrow morning,” or specific date/time windows)

3) Preferences:  
   • Any preference on cost vs. rating? (e.g., “cheapest available” vs. “4.5+ stars only”)  
   • Is someone 18+ available at home during the visit?

4) Your contact info for the booking:  
   • Name  
   • Mobile number  
   • Email (optional but recommended for confirmations)

Once you share these, I’ll find available plumbers and book an appointment for your leaking kitchen sink.
</action>
